mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(study_count), 0) AS studyCount, COALESCE(SUM(study_minutes), 0) AS studyMinutes, COALESCE(SUM(question_count), 0) AS questionCount, COALESCE(SUM(correct_count), 0) AS correctCount, COALESCE(SUM(stars), 0) AS stars, COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) AS points FROM edu_student_daily WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
